localChain.network: ephemeral Ganache local EVM; NOT Pharos mainnet/testnet
localChain.keys: ephemeral internally generated accounts; never exported

batch-executor.excludes: contract deployment; identical actions on fresh mappings; one action intentionally reverts

saga-executor.limitations: Lab accounting is reversible 1:1. Real swaps cannot roll back atomically and unwind can lose value. Unknown broadcast/receipt states require reconciliation; never blindly rebroadcast.

gas-fee-optimizer.gap: Organizer never misses deadline is only demonstrated for healthy controlled scheduler ticks; no unconditional timing guarantee.

arbitrage-scanner.limitations: Reads two local EVM reference-rate contracts with controlled prices; simulated execution explicitly allowed. Profit is a quoted estimate, not an executable market guarantee.
